lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Guided practice: reading a care tag

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy Ready for Life elementary sequence — Grade 3
Ready for Life v1 safety, supervision, and no-shame policy reference
Manuel Academy RFL G3 Unit 2 — clothing care and readiness routines
Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice reading a care tag. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: Three garments are laid on a table, each with its care tag flipped out and visible near the collar or side seam.
materials: learner-local: three garments with legible inside care tags

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Describe one specific care instruction that surprised you, such as a garment that must be washed only by hand or dried flat instead of in a dryer.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Tag location and symbol identification: Correctly locates the care tag and identifies the wash-temperature and drying symbols on all three garments. | Matching symbols to meaning: Correctly matches most identified symbols to their written meaning using the reference card. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner read the care tag on a bedsheet or pillowcase and compare its washing and drying instructions to the t-shirt's tag from this lesson.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can practice reading a care tag. I will do one step at a time and check one result.

duration.sessionPattern: 5 minutes model, 5–7 minutes guided try, 10–15 minutes learner task, 5 minutes evidence and retry check
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

localMaterials.label: three garments with legible inside care tags
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: reading a care tag worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: Three garments are laid on a table, each with its care tag flipped out and visible near the collar or side seam.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact reading a care tag decision or action.
Model move 2: Find the care tag on the first garment before opening the reference card.
Model move 3: Using the reference card, work through each garment's tag in order, symbol by symbol.

Model check: Tag location and symbol identification: Correctly locates the care tag and identifies the wash-temperature and drying symbols on all three garments. | Matching symbols to meaning: Correctly matches most identified symbols to their written meaning using the reference card.

resources.title: reading a care tag action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for reading a care tag.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-guided-card.
4. Complete the chosen route on swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-independent-card.
5. Save the small record on swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-evidence-record; use swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-retry-pair if a step is missed.

resources.title: reading a care tag coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: Three garments are laid on a table, each with its care tag flipped out and visible near the collar or side seam.
Coach direction: Find the care tag on the first garment before opening the reference card.
Learner prompt: Describe exactly where you found the care tag on the first garment (for example, inside the collar or along the side seam).
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: reading a care tag complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Using the reference card, work through each garment's tag in order, symbol by symbol.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I found the wash-temperature symbol on each garment's tag.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I found the drying symbol (tumble dry or line dry) on each garment's tag.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I checked for a special warning symbol, such as no bleach or no iron, on each garment's tag.
Response 4 (t2-p4): I matched every symbol I found to its written meaning on the reference card.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: reading a care tag minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Describe one specific care instruction that surprised you, such as a garment that must be washed only by hand or dried flat instead of in a dryer.

Success checks: Tag location and symbol identification: Correctly locates the care tag and identifies the wash-temperature and drying symbols on all three garments. | Matching symbols to meaning: Correctly matches most identified symbols to their written meaning using the reference card.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: reading a care tag supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional reading a care tag condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Tag location and symbol identification: Correctly locates the care tag and identifies the wash-temperature and drying symbols on all three garments. | Matching symbols to meaning: Correctly matches most identified symbols to their written meaning using the reference card..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

simulationRoute.title: reading a care tag — complete fictional route
simulationRoute.directions: Complete the reading a care tag task using the fictional condition and invented, non-sensitive details on the delivered independent card.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

learnerEvidence: one revision when a step changed
evidence.reflectionPrompt: Describe one specific care instruction that surprised you, such as a garment that must be washed only by hand or dried flat instead of in a dryer.
observableCriteria: Tag location and symbol identification: Correctly locates the care tag and identifies the wash-temperature and drying symbols on all three garments.
Matching symbols to meaning: Correctly matches most identified symbols to their written meaning using the reference card.

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Tag location and symbol identification: Correctly locates the care tag and identifies the wash-temperature and drying symbols on all three garments. | Matching symbols to meaning: Correctly matches most identified symbols to their written meaning using the reference card.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u02-l03-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
